use_case: Public generative AI chatbot used to scale cure and brine amounts to customer batch weights and to draft customer texts
vendor_or_model: Public generative AI chatbot vendor (large language model; free consumer account); consumer terms allow use of inputs to improve the service
source_evidence: EV-024 (chatbot account history); EV-025 (consumer terms); EV-008 (laptop browser history); EV-026 (no payment on statements); EV-033 (saved answers check)
data_categories: Recipes and cure formulations; batch weights; occasionally customer first names and pickup times
consequential_decision_category: None (no decisions about people); can affect physical safety through cure amounts
human_in_the_loop: Owner reads every answer; from 2026-08-31 cure amounts come only from the supplier's chart and the check is recorded on the batch sheet (POL-01 9.5)
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 424.21(c) via 303.1(b)(1) (curing agent limits); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (no customer data entered); FTC Act Section 5 background only
status: Restricted (approved 2026-08-31): the High-tier use (cure amounts) is prohibited; drafting customer texts without customer details remains, a Low-tier use

use_case: Cold-chain vendor's anomaly alert feature (flags unusual temperature patterns, such as a door left open or a compressor cycling more often)
vendor_or_model: Cold-chain monitoring vendor (feature in the SaaS dashboard; covered by the vendor's SOC 2 scope)
source_evidence: EV-002 (anomaly alert feature on); EV-005 (vendor SOC 2 scope)
human_in_the_loop: Owner reviews each anomaly alert; set-point alarms still fire regardless of the feature
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 303.1(b)(1) (product protection, through the alerting it supports)
status: In production; set-point alarms remain the primary alert
